notes: Street Tear satellites. 4000 LP are theme beatdown with no limited power staples. 8000 LP are era-constructed themes. Forbidden cards (Yata, CED, BLS-Envoy, HFD, Witch, Tribe-Infecting, etc.) are not used. Defender lists are wall/stall (high DEF, Gravity Bind, Jam Defender).

playground4000.name: Schoolyard Harpies
playground4000.flaw: Wants 3 Harpie Lady + 3 Elegant Egotist; opened 2 and 2. Hunting Ground never showed, so Follow Wind sits there instead. One Birdface.

playground4000.name: Cafeteria Red-Eyes
playground4000.flaw: Only 2 Red-Eyes and 1 Inferno Fire Blast. Pulled Summoned Skull and built around that instead of a 3rd dragon. Black Dragon's Chick is a 2-of.

playground4000.name: Library Elves
playground4000.flaw: Gemini Elf is a 2-of. Never opened Dark Magician, so Dark Magician Girl is the boss. Magician of Faith and Skilled Dark Magician fill the magician slot.

playground4000.name: Alley Scorpions (short)
playground4000.flaw: Don Zaloog is a 2-of. Never pulled Cliff the Trap Remover; Dark Scorpion Burglars is the stand-in. Mustering is a 1-of.

playground4000.name: Weekend Unions
playground4000.flaw: Has X-Head Cannon and Y-Dragon Head, never opened Z-Metal Tank. Cannon Soldier and Robotic Knight pad the machine slot. Extra has XY but not the full XYZ.

playground4000.name: Schoolyard Gaia
playground4000.flaw: One Gaia and one Curse of Dragon — the fusion is the dream, not the ratio. Celtic Guardian and Beaver Warrior are the rest of the knight pile.

playground4000.name: Cafeteria Ojamas
playground4000.flaw: All three colors, but Yellow is the only 3-of. Green and Black are 2. Ojama Trio is the trap they actually opened. Polymerization stands in for missing Ojama spells.

playground4000.name: Bus-stop Thunder
playground4000.flaw: Thunder Dragon is a 2-of so the search is inconsistent. Hyozanryu is the pet 2100 they wouldn't cut. Twin-Headed sits in Extra.

playground4000.name: Mixed Toolbox
playground4000.flaw: Wants a one-attribute recruiter engine. Ended up with 2 Giant Rat, 2 Flying Kamakiri, 1 UFO Turtle, 1 Mother Grizzly — a rainbow that does not search itself.

playground4000.name: Hinotama Homework
playground4000.flaw: Secret Barrel is a 2-of. Wave-Motion Cannon is a 1-of. Hinotama and Final Flame stand in for Just Desserts.

playground8000.name: Rooftop Ninjas (short)
playground8000.flaw: Sasuke and Strike Ninja are 2-ofs. White Ninja is a 1-of. Ninjitsu Art is 1 instead of 2. Fuhma Shuriken is the weird include.

playground8000.name: Weekend Horus
playground8000.flaw: Three LV4, only two LV6, one LV8. Luster Dragon is the vanilla they liked more than a 3rd LV6.

playground8000.name: Schoolyard Armed Dragon
playground8000.flaw: LV3 is a 3-of, LV5 is a 2-of, LV7 is a singleton. Masked Dragon stands in for a 3rd LV5.

playground8000.name: Library LV Swords
playground8000.flaw: Mystic Swordsman LV2 is maxed; LV4 is a 2-of; LV6 is a 1-of. Silent Swordsman LV3 is the other LV toy they owned.

playground8000.name: Alley Archfiends
playground8000.flaw: Archfiend Soldier is a 2-of. Pandemonium is a 2-of. Summoned Skull is the famous card they slotted because Terrorking kept eating their own spells.

playground8000.name: Union Dark Blade
playground8000.flaw: Dark Blade is a 3-of. Pitch-Dark Dragon is a 2-of. Kiryu is a singleton. Fusion sits in Extra even though the union count is thin.

playground8000.name: Buster + a Magician
playground8000.flaw: Two Buster Blader, one Dark Magician (the foil). Skilled Dark Magician is a 2-of. Dark Paladin is in Extra. No 3rd Buster, no Sage's Stone.

playground8000.name: No-Envoy Chaos
playground8000.flaw: Chaos Sorcerer is a 2-of. No Envoys (banned). Thunder Dragon and recruiters are LIGHT/DARK food, but the counts are 2/2/2 instead of a dedicated engine.

playground8000.name: Budget Necrovalley
playground8000.flaw: Spy and Guard are 2-ofs. No Chief. Necrovalley is a 2-of. Rite of Spirit is a 1-of; Waboku is the extra trap they owned.

playground8000.name: Ultimate Insect (gaps)
playground8000.flaw: LV1 and LV3 are 2-ofs; LV5 and LV7 are singletons. Flying Kamakiri is the WIND recruiter they had instead of a 3rd LV3.
